snippet.title: KLAS Tower! Simulator 3 - Update 4 New Trailer
snippet.description:
https://feelthere.com/shop/advertising/klas-las-vegas-airport/
Features and fuxes:

- Highly detailed representation of Las Vegas International Airport
- Detailed ground with taxi markings
- Updated long route calculations for arriving and departing aircraft
- Fixed taxiway connections and routing
- Fixed gate A_18 stuck after pushback
- Improved performance
- Added taxi signs
